features.name: Parse Option Value
features.description: Parses an option with a value and one positional argument, and returns both values.

features.name: Parse Positional Argument
features.description: Parses a required positional argument together with an option, and returns the positional value.

features.name: Parse Repeated Option
features.description: Parses three occurrences of the same option and returns their values in the order they were supplied.

features.name: Parse Switch
features.description: Parses a boolean switch on one command line and its absence on another, returning the switch state.

features.name: Bind Typed Model
features.description: Binds the command line to a typed model, including conversion of an integer option.

features.name: Generate Help
features.description: Builds the help text of the command, without writing it to a device.

features.name: Error Unknown Option
features.description: Parses a command line containing an undeclared option and returns the failure the library reports.

features.name: Error Missing Required Value
features.description: Parses a command line without a required option and returns the failure the library reports.

features.name: Error Invalid Type
features.description: Parses a non-numeric value for an integer option and returns the failure the library reports.

features.name: Error Missing Required Argument
features.description: Parses a command line without a required positional argument and returns the failure the library reports.
